remarks: Cozy-Chic 3BR in East Norwalk's Coveted Water Community. Step into coastal living with this freshly painted, stylish 3-bedroom townhouse-style apartment. Nestled in a quiet, friendly water community, you're just minutes from the East Norwalk train station, local eateries, the buzz of SONO, plus beaches, marinas, and parks. Set in a beautifully maintained 2-family home with standout curb appeal, this sun-filled apartment spans two levels. Main level: inviting living and dining rooms, a full bath with tub/shower combo, one bedroom, and a newly renovated kitchen featuring brand-new Quartz countertops and custom cabinetry-perfect for cooking and entertaining. Upper level: a serene primary bedroom, a secondary bedroom and a Jack and Jill full bathroom with shower/tub. Hardwood floors throughout, natural gas heat, and reserved off-street parking for two vehicles (plus ample street parking for guests). Basement with loads of storage and full size washer/dryer units. Exterior shed and bin for additional storage space. Landlord covers water; the tenant covers WiFi, electric, and gas. Minimum 660 credit score, proof of income, and references required. Live the coastal-cool lifestyle every day. Schedule your private showing today!
